entry.title: An equalizer for the backing track
entry.summary: Version 2026.10.28-001: an equalizer for Lite and Pro with presets, a Default and a curve for each song; previews kept between sessions with a size limit; finer volume steps; and a rebuild for video files that will not open.

entry.title: Test your screen, sound and songs before the party
entry.summary: Version 2026.10.25-001: Test songs and a Screen & sound test in Get Ready, a Get Ready button that shows green, yellow or red and keeps itself up to date, and folder scans that share the Import review.

entry.title: Simpler plans and a 30-Day Pro Pass
entry.summary: Version 2026.10.23-001: three plans (Free, Lite, Pro), tokens at $1, a $35 30-Day Pro Pass, and a 30-day free trial.

entry.title: A tidier dashboard, a guest panel, and your trial dates
entry.summary: Version 2026.10.17-002: a tidier host dashboard, a per-guest panel, trial start and end dates in the Wallet, and a Copy button for your Install ID.

entry.title: A tip jar on every guest’s phone
entry.summary: Pro hosts can show their own tip link, QR picture or text to copy (such as a Zelle email) on guests’ phones. Tips go straight to the host, with no fee from Jukoke.

entry.title: Approve some songs first
entry.summary: Pro hosts can hold songs that are too long, too short or repeated until they approve them, with song lengths shown in the queue and search.

entry.title: Get Ready: a guided start, and easier-to-read help text
entry.summary: NICE-Start, a guided checklist that gets you from install to your first song, plus clearer offline-drive errors and easier-to-read help text.

entry.title: Announce, a managed Ask the MC list, and a clearer end of session
entry.summary: Announce messages to every guest (Pro), a searchable Ask the MC list, a clearer end of session, and a plainer description of the stage name and PIN.

entry.title: Easier to join, easier to ask: release 2026.10.08-001
entry.summary: Two-step Wi-Fi and Jukoke join codes on every plan, plus Ask the MC private guest messages on Lite and Pro.

entry.title: Welcome to the Jukoke website
entry.summary: This is the new home for Jukoke: downloads, release notes and support all live here.
